title: FBI Photo B4
what_is_it: A monochrome still image captured by a U.S. military imaging system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The extracted source text is extremely corrupted and largely unreadable — most characters appear to be OCR artifacts from a low-quality monochrome image with HUD overlays.
The image was pre-redacted by the submitting agency before reaching AARO, meaning potentially identifying sensor or platform data was removed.
No accompanying mission report was provided, so there is no operational context for the sighting.
The date/time stamp shown in the image is confirmed incorrect, so no reliable timing can be derived from it.
This is a single still image from a single source with no corroborating data provided.
The narrative description in the metadata explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or investigative conclusion.

key_facts.value: Garbled — appears to reference dates like 2/31/99 and 31/93 which are invalid calendar dates

verifiable_claims.claim: The date displayed in the image (2/31/99) is an impossible calendar date, consistent with the metadata note that the system date/time was not properly set.
